report:
# FQ-EVERETT-RATIONAL-SECTOR-BOUNDARY

The source four-candidate exclusion was not a proof of irrationality. A new Lean theorem excludes every rational root of 5x²-5x+1, using the non-square 5 in Q. Native quadratic-field roots are (1/2,±1/10) in the basis 1,sqrt5. Separately, all normalized rational finite vectors have exact common-denominator multiplicities; no Born or Everett mechanism is derived.

Supported: Universal rational-pair fine graining and full rational-root exclusion are kernel checked; retained multi-outcome multiplicities and quadratic-field root coefficients are exact.

Remaining: Prove arbitrary finite-vector fine-graining transport and that the declared quadratic-field coefficients realize the intended physical readout. Counting is an admitted interpretation.
